record.title: IMX219 camera board with M12 lens, on the Radxa's 22-pin 0.5 mm MIPI CSI connector (2 data lanes as the rpi-camera-v2 overlay drives it), mounted upside down in the head

requires.name: VCC_3V3
requires.cite: part:radxa-zero-3w buses_the_microduck_uses.mipi_csi; the board must regulate 2.8/1.2/1.8 V itself (part:imx219 supplies[2] cite)
requires.current_from_basis: per-rail only on the die (VANA 33 mA + VDDL 100 mA streaming, part:imx219 Table 45); the board total through its own regulators is CANNOT DETERMINE.

requires.name: CSI_D1
requires.cite: part:radxa-zero-3w buses_the_microduck_uses.mipi_csi; overlay radxa-zero3-rpi-camera-v2 (media:51-65) — a Pi-Camera-v2-class 2-lane module; lanes D2/D3 unused is the lane's inference

uncertainties: Camera module part, ribbon part and ribbon length: CANNOT DETERMINE (docs §5 last row) — the wiring lane measures the floor off the placements.
Whether the module's ribbon is 22-pin 0.5 mm at both ends or 15-pin 1.0 mm (Pi style) at the camera end with an adapter: CANNOT DETERMINE.
